name: Silicone Suction Pad Phone Holder (Adhesive)
shortDescription: Sticky silicone suction pad that holds your phone to mirrors, tiles and glass.
description: A reusable silicone suction pad that sticks to the back of your phone or case and grips smooth surfaces. Film selfies on a mirror, watch videos on tiles, or keep your phone steady on a desk.

specifications.label: Colours
